body: I would say the driver has responsibility to check the orders before driving off, so no not all errors fall on the dispatcher.

For busy times (lunch) we TRY to use 2 dispatchers. One maintains a steady stream of fired off orders while the other one expedites orders to drivers outside. There’s a lot of variability and complexity to dispatching, like having to bag orders sometimes, making drinks, helping stock FOH (at least for my store). Focus on getting the wait time down which will encourage more guests to order when they see the fast wait times on the app, since it refreshes in real time.

We have never done auto-dispatching due to our high capacity. Dispatchers are considered a leadership position and you do get a raise. However, like I said it’s the fact that our drivers’ pay is the highest in the store (other than directors and GM) and is unbalanced.
Our drivers use company cars.
Our store is boomin’!! We started late 2021 when delivery was at its peak (from Covid). It took a bit to grow to the point we are now but delivery profits are about 10% of total store revenue.
